application_status.label: Applications open with no quota or designated season
application_status.detail: Current Embassy guidance says eligible New Zealand applicants may apply at any time. Applications must be made in person at the consular office responsible for the applicant's New Zealand residence.

change_control.review_note: New Zealand baseline verified against the Embassy of Japan in New Zealand Working Holiday page and current Auckland consular guidance.

summary_facts.label: Residence
summary_facts.value: New Zealand passport holder residing in New Zealand

summary_facts.label: Participation
summary_facts.value: Up to two Working Holiday visas; second application must be made in New Zealand

summary_facts.label: Funds baseline
summary_facts.value: NZ$3,000 with paid return ticket; NZ$4,000 without

summary_facts.label: Application route
summary_facts.value: In person at the Japanese office responsible for your New Zealand region

eligibility_rules.label: Do you hold a New Zealand passport?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: This route is for New Zealand passport holders.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you currently residing in New Zealand?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: New Zealand applicants must currently reside in New Zealand.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The New Zealand Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday and travel in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The New Zealand programme is for a long-term holiday; work should be casual/temporary and incidental.

eligibility_rules.label: Will dependent children accompany you?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The New Zealand Working Holiday route does not permit accompanying dependent children.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the good-health and no-criminal-record requirements?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The programme requires good health and no criminal record.

funds_rule.input_label: Funds shown in your New Zealand bank statement (NZ$)

jurisdiction.label: Japanese consular office responsible for your New Zealand residence
jurisdiction.description: Applicants must reside in New Zealand and lodge in person with the office responsible for their region.
jurisdiction.ui_help: Choose the office responsible for your region. Auckland requires an appointment; Wellington and Christchurch currently do not.

options.label: Auckland and upper North Island
options.mission_detail: Auckland and upper North Island residents apply through the Consulate-General in Auckland. Current guidance says an online appointment is required.

options.label: Christchurch / Canterbury
options.mission_label: Consular Office of Japan in Christchurch
options.mission_detail: Christchurch and Canterbury residents apply through the Christchurch consular office; current guidance says booking is not required.

options.label: Wellington / lower North Island / South Island excluding Canterbury
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in New Zealand — Wellington
options.mission_detail: Wellington, lower North Island and South Island residents outside Canterbury use the Embassy in Wellington; current guidance says booking is not required.

options.label: I currently reside outside New Zealand
options.mission_label: New Zealand Working Holiday route may not apply
options.mission_detail: Current guidance requires New Zealand passport holders to reside in New Zealand when applying.
options.issue: The New Zealand Working Holiday route requires the applicant to be currently residing in New Zealand.

document_checklist.title: Valid New Zealand passport
document_checklist.description: Passport must remain valid through your departure from Japan and have space for the visa label.

document_checklist.title: Visa application form and photo
document_checklist.description: Complete and sign the current visa application form and provide a recent 45×35mm photo.

document_checklist.title: One-page signed cover letter
document_checklist.description: Explain why you are applying, what interests you and what you want to achieve.

document_checklist.title: Current CV
document_checklist.description: Prepare an up-to-date CV covering personal, educational and employment history.

document_checklist.title: Detailed Stay Programme
document_checklist.description: Use the official template and show specific locations and activities for the proposed stay.

document_checklist.title: Three months of bank transactions
document_checklist.description: Provide an official statement showing at least NZ$3,000 with a paid return ticket, or NZ$4,000 without one.

document_checklist.title: Flight details
document_checklist.description: If a return ticket has not been purchased, the funds baseline increases by NZ$1,000.

preparation_checklist.title: Read the current New Zealand official guidance
preparation_checklist.description: Check the Embassy page and your regional office instructions immediately before applying.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm the correct regional office
preparation_checklist.description: Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch have different appointment arrangements.

preparation_checklist.title: Plan for in-person lodgement
preparation_checklist.description: Current guidance requires the applicant to submit the Working Holiday application in person.

preparation_checklist.title: Consider travel insurance
preparation_checklist.description: Insurance is optional in the checklist but may be requested for high-risk activities such as skiing/snowboarding.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final source check
preparation_checklist.description: Confirm current processing times, appointments and required documents before lodging.
